question: Seven players Virat, Rahul, Rohit, Surya, Hardik, Rishabh and Deepak are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Rohit is second to the left of Virat. Virat is fourth to the right of Deepak: Hardik is to immediate left of Deepak. Surya is not the immediate neighbour of Rohit. Rishabh is second to the right of Hardik. Who is fourth to the right of Hardik?
solution:
